shortDescription: Module for setup of ServiceEngine Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: cloud_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type cloud. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: container_mode
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: container_type
options.description: Enum options - CONTAINER_TYPE_BRIDGE, CONTAINER_TYPE_HOST, CONTAINER_TYPE_HOST_DPDK. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as CONTAINER_TYPE_HOST.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: controller_created
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: controller_ip
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: data_vnics
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enable_state
options.description: Inorder to disable se set this field appropriately. Enum options - SE_STATE_ENABLED, SE_STATE_DISABLED_FOR_PLACEMENT, SE_STATE_DISABLED, SE_STATE_DISABLED_FORCE, SE_STATE_DISABLED_WITH_SCALEIN, SE_STATE_DISABLED_NO_TRAFFIC, SE_STATE_DISABLED_FORCE_WITH_MIGRATE. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SE_STATE_ENABLED.

options.name: flavor
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: host_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type vimgrhostruntime. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: hypervisor
options.description: Enum options - DEFAULT, VMWARE_ESX, KVM, VMWARE_VSAN, XEN. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: mgmt_vnic
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as VM name unknown.

options.name: nsxt_no_hotplug
options.description: If set to true, controller does not hotplugg the vnics. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: resources
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: se_group_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type serviceenginegroup. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
